script.title: Fake bank fraud team
script.summary: A caller claims to be the bank's fraud team and wants the money moved to a 'safe account'.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Good afternoon, this is the fraud department at your bank. Is this Mrs. Margaret Hale?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: We have found suspicious activity, and someone is trying to take money out of your savings right now.

lines.speaker: parent
lines.text: Oh dear. What should I do?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: You must act immediately. We need you to move your savings into a safe account by wire transfer.

lines.speaker: parent
lines.text: A wire transfer? I've never done that.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I will guide you. Please do not tell the tellers at your branch, because we believe one of them is involved.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: All of it. Seven thousand dollars. Do it now before the thieves get there first.

payment_attempt.request: Send $7,000 by wire to the safe account the bank gave me.

events.text:
Your parent’s payment of $7,000 to “safe account” was paused — this matches scam patterns.  
“Good afternoon, this is the fraud department at your bank. Is this Mrs. Margaret Hale?”  
“You must act immediately. We need you to move your savings into a safe account by wire transfer.”  
Please call them now. Reply KEEP if the payment should stay blocked, or RELEASE if it’s safe. We’re here to help.
events.sent:
Held action: send_money {'payee': 'safe account', 'amount': 7000}
The call has two worrying moments, shown as {Q1} and {Q2}.

events.text: A caller impersonating the bank’s fraud department contacted the parent, raising a gate amber by asking if they were Mrs. [PARENT]. The caller then raised gate red by claiming suspicious activity and demanding immediate action to move funds via wire transfer. The caller further raised gate red by instructing the parent not to inform bank tellers, alleging internal involvement. The system paused the payment request to transfer $7,000, and the account balance remained unchanged. The family responded with KEEP, and the payment remains cancelled.

- Step 3: caller said “You must act immediately. We need you to move your savings into a safe account by wire transfer.” (gate red)
- Step 4: caller said “I will guide you. Please do not tell the tellers at your branch, because we believe one of them is involved.” (gate red)
- Held: send_money {'payee': 'safe account', 'amount': 7000}. Balance unchanged at $12,450.00.
- The family replied KEEP and the payment stays cancelled.
